newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Ten said killed by poison gas in Pakistani city.
newsitem.headline: Ten said killed by poison gas in Pakistani city.

text.p: About 10 people died and more than 100 fell unconscious when poisonous gas leaked from cylinders on a truck in the Pakistani city of Lahore overnight, the official news agency APP reported on Thursday.
The agency said the gas leak occurred after the truck had an accident in the Mughalpura area of the city.
APP said panic gripped the area after the incident and the army took control and launched a relief operation.
The fire brigade and civil rescue workers also rushed to the scene to help hundreds of affected residents, it said.

The governor of Punjab province, Khawaja Ahmed Tariq Rahim, was supervising relief operations on the spot. The provincial administration declared an emergency at all hospitals as victims continued to be evacuated from the area, APP said.
There was no immediate word on the nature of the gas that had caused the disaster.
